model.license: Apache-2.0 subject to gpt-oss usage policy
model.role_in_ramp: open-weight target model input embedding space for span clustering

runtime.why_not_hosted_api: RAMP needs GPT-OSS input embedding-layer vectors; hosted chat APIs do not expose model.get_input_embeddings()(input_ids).

extraction.tokenization: model tokenizer with chat/template disabled for isolated spans unless the experiment explicitly tests chat context
extraction.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling over non-padding tokens
extraction.normalization: l2_normalize pooled vector before centroid construction
extraction.batching: batch spans by token length and record batch size in metadata
extraction.precision: bfloat16 preferred on supported GPUs; record actual dtype
extraction.randomness: disable sampling; set deterministic seeds where framework support allows

centroid_build.corpus: benchmark-derived span corpus plus reviewed hard benign near-neighbors
centroid_build.centroid_method_v0: mean of normalized span vectors per domain/subcluster_role/subcluster_id, followed by l2 normalization
centroid_build.heldout_policy: hold out benchmark source splits or source families before threshold calibration

runpod.recommended_first_gpu: single H200, H100 80GB, or A100 80GB GPU
runpod.recommended_template: RunPod PyTorch/Jupyter pod or custom CUDA image with Transformers
